risk_note: RV2 (same device, many accounts, BR-ID-37; migration 0025). login_logs gains a nullable device_hash (64-hex CHECK, partial index on app_id, device_hash, created_at; existing rows not backfilled, pre-launch) written by SMS login from the verified device row; risk_hits gains a partial unique index for SAME_DEVICE_MULTI_ACCOUNT. risk judge(handle, {app_id, user_id, ref}) ranks accounts per device_hash by first login inside the closed window [now - 720 h, now] from the injected Clock (ties by login_logs.id), applies the merge-tombstone dedupe per device and window (risk.merge_tombstone_dedupe), marks the 3rd account onward (risk.device_login_accounts_limit) and writes one manual_review risk_hits row per hit device; a transaction-level advisory lock per withdrawal serialises judgements and a repeat replays the first decision time; config reads run under a savepoint. identity implements the query port (dependency inversion). No payout, ban or login blocking; judge has no business caller yet (B2-05). Persisting non-hit results and the config-read failure policy are tracked by ledger task B1-03n (#376), required before B2-05 wires judge. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
